original The report records factual findings from the specified agreed procedures on institutional claims and supporting records. An agreed-upon-procedures report is not an assurance opinion. Readers need the complete procedures, criteria and findings to assess its meaning. It does not establish clinical outcomes. Original source: Original four-page SRS 4400 report.
